blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A robot's world model must remember objects that leave the camera's view. FloWM, a learned world model, keeps them in a spatial grid of features that it moves with five built-in velocities. A node memory instead keeps each object's position and velocity as numbers. We compare them in FloWM's own block world, with an oracle-fed Kalman tracker as the node memory. How the grid is read changes its score: a single-cell probe finds 66% of out-of-view blocks, while FloWM's own probe 89%. FloWM also scores 8 points higher in view although no frame is shown, which we attribute to its write-back of its own predictions. Out of view, the tracker reaches FloWM's range in 14KB against 5.6MB, with no probe. On diagonal motion, outside its five velocities, FloWM finds 11% of blocks even after fine-tuning, while the unchanged tracker keeps 93%. Faster blocks defeat both until one more allowed speed takes the tracker to 94%, where FloWM's built-in shifts would need 25 copies of its grid. A learned node memory must still replace the oracles and handle velocity under noise, long gaps, and the bounce.
blocks.zh: 机器人的世界模型必须记住离开相机视野的物体. FloWM,一个有学问的世界模型,将它们保存在一个具有五个内置速度的特征的空间网格上. 取而代之的是节点内存将每个对象的位置和速度保持为数字. 我们在FloWM自己的块状世界中比较它们,一个以神谕为原料的卡尔曼追踪器作为节点记忆. 被读取的格子如何会改变它的分数:单细胞探测器发现66%的出视区块,而FloWM自己的探测器则发现89%. FloWM虽然没有显示帧,但是在视图中也得分更高8分,我们将此归结于它对自身预测的回写. 出道后,追踪器以14KB对5.6MB达到FloWM的射程,没有探测器. 在对角运动上,FloWM在其5个速度之外,即使在微调后也会发现11%的区块,而不变的跟踪器则保留了93%. 更快的块将两者都击败,直到再有一个允许的速度将追踪器带到94%,其中FloWM的内置转会需要25个副本的网格. 一个有学问的节点记忆仍然必须取代甲骨文,在噪音下处理速度,长相间隙,和回弹.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A robot that turns away from a moving cart must still know where the cart has gone. Robots increasingly plan with learned world models [ 12 , 32 , 1 ] , so these models need a memory for objects that leave the camera’s view. Where should that memory keep a moving object? FloWM [ 20 ] keeps a top-down grid of learned features and moves it with a fixed set of built-in velocities. Its motion prior, what it assumes about motion, is therefore part of the memory’s layout. Our node-based memory platform instead stores one node per object, with its position and velocity as numbers.
blocks.zh: 一个从移动的推车转走的机器人,仍然必须知道推车去了哪里. 机器人越来越多地用学习过的世界模型[12,32,1]进行计划,因此这些模型需要保存离开相机视野的物体的内存. 记忆应该把移动物体放在哪里? FloWM [20] 保持自上而下被学习到的特征网格并用固定的一套内置速度来移动. 因此,它先动,即它假设的运动,是记忆布局的一部分。 我们的以节点为基础的内存平台相反,每个对象存储一个节点,其位置和速度作为数字.

blocks.en: Other video world models add a memory for consistency when the camera returns [ 30 , 14 ] , or keep state for subjects out of view [ 9 , 5 ] . Related to a node memory are tracking by detection [ 3 ] , models of object permanence [ 26 , 27 ] and object-centric models with one representation per object [ 21 , 17 , 7 , 8 , 24 ] . Memories are usually judged by probes, networks trained to read out a property [ 18 , 10 , 29 ] , whose scores reflect the probe as well as the memory [ 13 , 2 ] . Benchmarks test what world models remember [ 22 , 23 , 4 , 11 , 19 ] , and others question what replay quality or next-step accuracy shows [ 16 , 28 , 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 其他相机世界模型在相机返回 [30, 14] 时会为一致性添加一个内存, 或为视线外的主体保持状态 [9, 5]. 与节点内存相关的是:通过检测[3],物体永久性模型[26,27]和以物体为中心的模型,每个物体[21,17,7,8,24]有一个表示. 记忆通常由探测器判断,网络训练来读出一个属性[18,10,29],其分数既反映探测器,也反映内存[13,2]. 基准测试世界模型所记得的[22、23、4、11、19],其他人则质疑重播质量或下一步骤的准确性显示的[16、28、31]。

blocks.en: We compare the two designs on FloWM’s own task, a room of sliding blocks. Each memory receives 70 steps of context and then predicts 70 steps from the agent’s actions alone. FloWM works from pixels, and the node memory is a Kalman tracker with oracle inputs: the simulator gives it block masks and slightly noisy positions. The tracker as-is is not a deployable system.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了FloWM自己的两个设计,一个滑行区块的房间。 每个记忆都得到70个步骤的上下文,然后预测仅从代理人的行动中就能得到70个步骤. FloWM工作来自像素,节点内存是一个有甲骨文输入的卡尔曼跟踪器:模拟器给予它块口罩和略为出声的位置. 追踪器不是可部署系统。

blocks.en: Does the grid hold a block’s position, or does the probe compute it (Sec. 3.1 )? On FloWM’s own setting, how close does a node memory come (Sec. 3.2 )? What happens outside the built-in velocities (Sec. 3.3 )? What stands between the tracker and a full platform? (Sec. 3.4 )?
blocks.zh: 电网是否占据了块的位置,或者探测器是否计算出它(第3.1节)? 在FloWM自己的设定中,一个节点记忆会有多近(第3.2节)? 内置速度之外会发生什么(第3.3节)? 追踪器和全站台之间是什么? (第3.4节)?

blocks.en: 2 Two memories
blocks.zh: 2个 两个回忆

blocks.en: 2.1 Environment and protocol
blocks.zh: 2.1 环境和议定书

blocks.en:
Dynamic Block World [ 20 ] is a Miniworld [ 6 ] room (Fig. 1 a) whose floor is a grid of cells. Each evaluation video holds six blocks, one per color, which slide across the floor and bounce off the walls.
An agent moves one cell or turns 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} per step and sees through a 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} camera. Each video has a context phase of 70 frames with actions and a prediction phase of 70 actions without frames.
blocks.zh:
Dynamic Block World[20]是一个迷你世界 [6] 房间(图 1 a),其地上为细胞网. 每部评价视频都包含有6个街区,每个颜色1个,它们会滑出地上从墙上跳出.
一个特工每步移动一个细胞或转出90分,然后通过60分60分的相机看到. 每段视频的上下文阶段为有动作的70帧,没有帧的70个动作的预测阶段.

blocks.en: Figure 1: (a) The room from above. Solid arrows show motion in the standard setting, and dashed arrows the diagonal and speed-2 (double head) motion that the varied setting adds. (b) One prediction step of FloWM’s grid memory. (c) The tracker, a node memory.
blocks.zh: 图1 (a) 从上面到后面的房间。 固态箭头在标准设置中显示运动,而被破折的箭头会使各种设置所添加的对角和速度-2(双头)运动. (b) FloWM网格记忆的一个预测步骤。 (c) 跟踪器,一个节点记忆。

blocks.en: At every predicted step, each memory names, for each block, one cell of a grid centered on the agent. Only the block’s exact cell is correct, so chance is below 0.1%. A sighting is a context frame in which the block is visible. No frame is shown during prediction. We call a block in view at a step when it lies inside the field of view the camera would have then, and out of view otherwise.
blocks.zh: 在每一个预言的步骤,每个内存名称,每个区块,一个以代理人为中心的网格细胞. 只有区块的精确单元格是正确的,所以概率低于0.1%. 取景是块可见的上下文框架. 预测时不显示帧 。 我们叫一个街区,在一步,当它位于 视野的球场里, 相机本来会有, 离开视野。

blocks.en: In the standard setting , which follows FloWM’s published data, every block moves one cell per step along one floor axis. In our varied setting , each block draws a random nonzero velocity with whole-number components from − 2 -2 to 2 2 cells per step. Only 17% of blocks then move as in the standard setting ( built-in ), and 16% move one cell per step on both axes ( diagonal ). The other 67% move two cells per step on some axis ( speed 2 ). We tested on 256 standard and 1,024 varied videos, and fitted probes and tracker settings on separate tuning and training videos (Apps. A and C ).
blocks.zh: 在遵循 FloWM 公布的数据的标准设置中,每个区块每一步移动一个单元格,沿着一楼轴. 在不同的设定中,每个区块绘制一个随机的非零速度,每个步骤的整数组件从−2-2到2个单元格. 然后只有17%的区块像标准设置一样移动(内置),16%的区块在两轴上每步移动一个单元格(对角). 其他67%在某些轴上每步移动两个细胞(速度为2. 我们测试了256个标准视频和1 024个不同视频,并安装了探测器和跟踪器设置,分别使用调制和培训视频(pp.A和C)。

blocks.en: 2.2 FloWM’s grid memory
blocks.zh: 2.2 FloWM 的网格内存

blocks.en:
FloWM is trained end to end to predict camera frames.
Its memory is a top-down grid around the agent, 33 × 33 33\times 33 cells that each hold 256 learned features. The memory holds five copies of this grid, one per built-in velocity: standing still, and one cell per step in each of the four axis directions (Fig. 1 b). During each time-step, FLoWM’s memory does four operations: Move : every copy shifts by its own velocity, and all copies shift or rotate against the agent’s motion. These built-in shifts carry a block’s content while it is out of view. Mix : a learned 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution combines the copies, so content can change copies when a block bounces. Render : in the prediction phase, a learned decoder renders the predicted frame from the cells in view. Write : a learned transformer writes a frame into the cells in view. It writes the camera frame during context and its own rendered frame during prediction, which we call the write-back .
blocks.zh:
FloWM被训练出结束来预测相机帧.
它的内存是一个由上而下环绕着特质的网格,33×3333\times 33个细胞,每个细胞都有256个所学的特征. 内存持有此网格的5个拷贝,每个内置速度1个:站立不动,四个轴向每个方向每步1个单元格(图1b). 在每一步的时间里,FLOWM的记忆有四个操作: 移动 : 每一份副本按自己的速度转动, 所有副本都按代理的动作转动或旋转. 这些内置的班次会带出一个街区的内容, Mix :一个学习了的3×3 3\times 3的分解结合了拷贝,所以当块回弹时内容可以改变拷贝. Render : 在预测阶段,一个有学问的解码器使来自细胞的预测框架被查看. 写:一个有学识的变压器在视图中将一个框架写入单元格. 它在上下文时写相机框,在预测时写出自己的渲染相机框,我们称之为回写相机框.

blocks.en: The memory never stores a position as a number, so a probe must read it. The memory can carry only motion that the five copies and the mix can express. Its size grows with the area of the room times the number of velocities, not with the number of objects.
blocks.zh: 内存从不存储一个位置作为数字,因此探测器必须读取. 内存只能携带由五份和混音能表达的动作. 它的大小会随着房间面积的倍数而增长,而不是随着物体的数量而增长.

blocks.en: 2.3 A node memory with oracle perception
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 有先知感知的节点记忆

blocks.en: A node memory stores one node per object (Fig. 1 c). Each node holds a position and a velocity as numbers, their uncertainties, and appearance features. A node moves by its own velocity, so no velocity is built into the memory’s layout. The tracker keeps one Kalman filter [ 15 ] per block as its node, called a track. It matches detections to tracks by distance and color, in the style of SORT [ 3 ] . It has no trained networks. The simulator provides what a learned node memory must produce. These oracles are block masks, positions with one pixel of noise and their uncertainty, the walls, and at readout each detection’s identity, linking tracks to blocks (App. C ). A minimal working node memory therefore still needs four learned parts: a detector that finds blocks and estimates their floor positions from pixels, a readout that links nodes to objects without true identities, a bounce model that does not know the walls, and velocity estimates that hold up without hand-set allowed speeds.
blocks.zh: 一个节点内存存储每个对象一个节点(图1 c). 每个节点都有一个位置和一个速度作为数字,它们的不确定性和外观特征. 一个节点按自己的速度移动,因此内存的布局中没有构建出速度. 追踪器每个区块保留了1个卡尔曼滤波器[15]作为它的节点,称为"跑道". 它以SORT [3] 的风格,按照距离和颜色将检测结果与轨迹相匹配. 它没有经过培训的网络。 模拟器提供了学习出的一个节点记忆必须产生的东西. 这些甲骨文是块口罩,位置有一像素的噪音和它们的不确定性,墙壁,在读出每个探测器的身份时,将轨道与块相连接(App. C.). 因此,一个最小的工作节点内存仍需要四个学习到的部分:一个探测器从像素中找到块并估计出其地平面位置,一个将节点与没有真实身份的物体相连接的读取出,一个不知道墙壁的回弹模型,以及一个没有手设定允许的速度而能保持的速度估计.

blocks.en: Like FloWM, the tracker has a prior over speeds. A small error in a velocity estimated from noisy positions grows into a large position error over a long gap without sightings. The tracker therefore snaps each axis of a track’s velocity to an allowed speed, which we call speed snapping . On the standard setting the allowed speeds are 0 and 1 cell per step, fitted on training videos.
blocks.zh: 和FloWM一样,追踪器具有先行超速. 从吵吵的姿势估计出的一个速度上的小错误,在没有目光的情况下,在很长的空隙上发展成一个很大的姿势错误. 因此,追踪器将轨道速度的每个轴向允许的速度相接,我们称之为快快。 在标准设定上,允许的速度为每步0和1个单元格,安装在训练录像上。

blocks.en: 3.1 Does the grid hold a position, or does the probe compute it?
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 网格有位置,还是探测器会计算?

blocks.en: We used two probes to answer this question. A convolutional probe , rebuilt from FloWM’s appendix, sees the whole grid and has 7.06M parameters per head, more than half of FloWM’s own 12.8M. A single-cell probe applies one linear map of 1,282 parameters to each cell’s own features. It finds a block only where the memory stores it in the block’s own cell. We trained one probe head per block color on frozen memory states (App. B ). For blocks in view the single-cell probe finds the position, and for blocks out of view the convolutional probe computes part of it. The two probes agree on blocks in view and disagree out of view (Table 2 , top). There the single-cell probe finds 66% of blocks and the convolutional probe 89%. The extra hits need neighboring cells or a nonlinear combination of features.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个探测器来回答这个问题. 从FloWM的附录中重建的进取探测器可以看到整个网格,每头有7.06M参数,超过FloWM自己12.8M的一半. 单细胞探测器将1,282个参数的线性映射应用于每个细胞自身的特征. 只有在记忆存储于该区自己的牢房中时, 我们在被冻结的记忆状态上每块颜色训练一个探测器头(App. 对于在单细胞探测器中发现位置的区块,对于在视野外的区块,演化探测器计算出其中的一部分. 两种探测器在取景地上就区块达成一致,而异地取景(表2,上). 在那里,单细胞探测器发现了66%的区块和89%的演化探测器. 附加命中需要相邻的细胞或非线性特征组合.

blocks.en: No block is observed during prediction, yet FloWM, read by the convolutional probe, scores 8 points higher in view than out of view. The difference holds at every time since the last sighting from 5 steps on (Fig. 2 ) † \dagger , while the tracker shows none. FloWM’s score also rises by 5 points when a block enters view † \dagger (App. D ). We attribute both to the write-back, which rewrites the cells in view from FloWM’s own rendered frames. The write-back adds no observation, but in-view scores depend on rendering as well as memory, so we compare memories out of view for fairness. † † footnotetext: † \dagger marks a choice made after seeing results (App. I )

blocks.en: 3.2 On FloWM’s own setting, how close does a node memory come?
blocks.zh: 3.2 在FloWM自己的设定中,节点记忆会有多近?

blocks.en: With oracle perception, a node memory reaches FloWM’s range. Out of view the tracker finds 91% of blocks, and FloWM, read by the convolutional probe, finds 89% (Table 2 , top). We call this the same range and not a win, because our rebuilt probe scores 90% overall where FloWM’s authors report 96%. In view FloWM leads by about 6 points. The inputs also differ, since FloWM perceives from pixels and the tracker receives oracle detections. The tracker’s state takes 14KB against 5.6MB for FloWM’s five copies of the grid (App. H ), from which FloWM also renders frames. The tracker’s positions are numbers, so no probe is needed to read them once tracks are linked to objects.
blocks.zh: 以神谕感知,节点记忆会达到FloWM的范围. 从观点来看,追踪器发现了91%的区块,而FloWM(由革命探测器读取)发现了89%(表2,上). 因为我们重建的探测器在FloWM的作者报告96%时, 在视野中FloWM领先约6分. 输入也有所不同,因为FloWM能从像素中感知到,而跟踪器接收到甲骨文检测. 追踪器的状态为 FloWM 的五份网格(App. H)取用14KB, 追踪器的位置是数字,所以一旦追踪器与物体相连,就不需要探测器来读取.

blocks.en: 3.3 What happens outside the built-in velocities?
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 内在速度之外会发生什么?

blocks.en: Each memory loses blocks that move outside its motion prior, and the known fixes differ in cost. On varied test videos, FloWM’s released model finds 73% of built-in blocks but 4% of diagonal and speed-2 blocks (Table 2 , bottom). Using MSE, its prediction error on frames is 23 times higher than on the standard setting. Fine-tuning or retraining on varied videos lowers it, yet probes trained on those videos find at most 13% of diagonal and speed-2 blocks.
blocks.zh: 每个内存都会失去在运动前运动外运动的块,已知的修补方法在成本上有所不同. 在不同的测试视频中,FloWM的发布模式发现73%的内置区块,而4%的对角和速度-2区块(表2,下方). 使用MSE,它在帧上的预测误差是标准设置的23倍. 精细调整或再培训各种视频会降低其质量,然而在这些视频上训练的探测器发现的对角和速度-2区块最多只有13%.

blocks.en: The tracker loses speed-2 blocks in the same way. Unchanged, with allowed speeds 0 and 1, it keeps diagonal blocks, which per-axis speeds can express, and finds 5% of speed-2 blocks. Without speed snapping it finds about 60% of them, so for the tracker a wrong prior costs more than none (App. F ). With the allowed speeds refitted to 0, 1 and 2 on varied training videos, it finds 94% of diagonal and speed-2 blocks. With exact positions the tracker needs no allowed speeds and finds 97% of all blocks. Covering the varied setting’s 24 velocities with built-in shifts would take 25 copies of the grid, instead of five [ 20 , their Apps. F and G.1] . Training that model is out of scope for this paper.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: On the standard setting, where both priors cover the motion, a node memory with oracle perception scores in the same range as FloWM, which works from pixels. When the prior is wrong, both memories struggle to accurately track blocks. Our evidence qualifies the workshop’s Motion 2: explicit dynamics generalize only as far as their motion prior reaches for both memories. We tested new dynamics, not new goals, and no implicit model. It supports Motion 6: the same memory scores differently with a different probe, and FloWM’s in-view scores rise through its own write-back, not through memory. Fair comparisons should report the probe and score objects out of view.

blocks.en: A.1 Environment
blocks.zh: A.1 环境

blocks.en: Dynamic Block World [ 20 ] is a room built in Miniworld [ 6 ] (Fig. 1 a). The floor is a grid of cells, and the walls are 16 cells apart. Colored blocks, each 0.7 cells wide, slide across the floor and bounce off the walls. An agent moves through the room in steps of one whole cell and turns in steps of 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} . It sees the room through a camera with a 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} field of view, as 128 × 128 128\times 128 color frames.
blocks.zh: Dynamic Block World [20]是一座建于"迷你世界" [6] (图 1 a). 地上是细胞的网格,墙壁有16个细胞相隔. 有色块,每宽0.7个细胞,会滑过地上并从墙上弹出. 一个特工用一个整间牢房的阶梯穿过房间,然后转动90分90分90分的阶梯。 它通过一个相机看到房间,有一个60 ∘ 60^{\ Circ}的视野,作为128×128128\times 128色框.

blocks.en: Each video has two phases. In the context phase , a model sees 70 frames together with the agent’s actions. In the prediction phase , the model receives only the agent’s next 70 actions and sees no frames. We use two settings that differ only in how the blocks move.
blocks.zh: 每段视频分两个阶段. 在背景阶段,一个模型看到70个框架与代理人的行动。 在预测阶段,模型只接收代理的下70个动作,没有看到帧. 我们使用两种不同的设置, 只在区块如何移动上有所不同。

blocks.en: In the standard setting , which follows the generator settings of FloWM’s published data, every block moves one cell per step along one of the two floor axes. We created a varied setting , in which each block gets a random nonzero velocity whose components are whole numbers of cells per step between − 2 -2 and 2 2 . Only 16.9% of blocks in the varied setting move as they would in the standard setting. Another 15.8% move diagonally, one cell per step on each axis. The remaining 67.3% move two cells per step on at least one axis. We generated both settings with FloWM’s own version of Miniworld. In the varied setting, blocks faster than one cell per step move in one-cell sub-steps, so that they bounce off the walls instead of passing through them.
blocks.zh: 在遵循 FloWM 已发布数据的生成器设置的标准设置中,每个区块会沿着两层轴中的一层每步移动一个单元格. 我们创造了一个不同的设定,每个区块都得到一个随机的非零速度,其成分是− 2 - 2 和 2. 2 之间的整数细胞. 在不同的设置中,只有16.9%的区块会像在标准设置中那样移动. 另外15.8%的对角移动,每个轴上每步一个单元格. 其余67.3%在至少一个轴上每步移动两个单元格. 我们用FloWM自己的迷你世界版本创建了两种设置。 在不同的设定中,区块速度快于每步一个细胞在一细胞子步中移动的速度,这样它们就会从墙上反弹而去,而不是穿过它们.

blocks.en: A.2 FloWM’s memory in detail
blocks.zh: A.2 FloWM的详细记忆

blocks.en:
FloWM keeps its memory as a top-down map of the floor around the agent. The map is a 33 × 33 33\times 33 grid of cells centered on the agent, and one cell of the map covers one cell of the floor. Each cell holds a vector of 256 learned features, and content about a block is meant to sit in the cell where the block is. The memory holds five copies of this grid. Each copy is tied to one velocity from a fixed set, the built-in velocities .
The five velocities are standing still and moving one cell per step in each of the four axis directions (Fig. 1 b). A block that moves in the + x +x direction should therefore be stored in the + x +x copy.
blocks.zh:
FloWM保留了它的内存,作为代理商周围地层的自上而下地图. 地图为33×33相33相33相33格的细胞网,以特质为中心,地图上的一个细胞覆盖了一层的细胞. 每个细胞拥有256个被学习到的特性的向量,关于一个区块的内容就是为了坐在该区块所在的区块. 内存有5个本网格. 每份都绑在一个固定集的速率上 内置速度
五个速度都站稳了,在四个轴向中每个方向每步移动一个单元格(图1b). 因此,向+x+x方向移动的块应被存储在+x+x副本中.

blocks.en: Every step, FloWM first moves and mixes the copies. In the context phase, it then writes the camera frame into the memory. In the prediction phase, it then renders a frame from the memory and writes that frame back into the memory.
blocks.zh: 每一步,FloWM首先移动并混合拷贝. 在上下文相中,再将相机帧写入内存. 在预测阶段,它再从内存中制作出一个帧并将这个帧写回内存.

blocks.en: • Move. FloWM shifts each copy by one cell in that copy’s direction and leaves the still copy in place. It also moves all copies against the agent’s own motion, so that the grid stays centered on the agent: a step forward shifts the grid by one cell, and a turn rotates the grid by 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} and turns each copy’s direction with it. These moves are built in and are not learned. They carry a block’s content along with the block, even while the block is out of view. • Mix. A learned 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution combines the five copies, separately for each of the 256 features (57.6k parameters). This step can move content from one copy to another, which a bounce requires, since a block that hits a wall must move from the + x +x copy to the − x -x copy. Because the convolution spans neighboring cells, it can also move content by up to one cell. The mix applies the same weights at every cell, however, so it cannot tell where a wall is, and the content that turns a block at a wall must come from what the write stored. • Render. During the prediction phase, a learned decoder renders the predicted camera frame from the cells in view, after the move and the mix and before that step’s write. • Write. A learned transformer writes a frame into the memory. It updates only a fixed set of 177 cells, a 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} wedge in front of the agent that covers the camera’s view, in all five copies. During the context phase it writes the real camera frame. During the prediction phase there is no camera frame, so FloWM writes the frame it has just rendered at the same step. We call this the write-back .
blocks.zh: • 移动。 FloWM 将每份副本按该副本的方向逐一移出一行,并将保留该副本。 它也会将所有复制件与代理件的自動相抗衡,从而使电网保持以代理件为中心:向前一步将电网转换为一格,再转一圈将电网旋转为90-∘90-^{\90-^{\Circ},并随其转出每个复制件的方向. 这些动作是建构的,没有学过. 他们带着一个街区的内容, • 混合。 一个被学习到的3 × 3 3\times 3 曲折结合了这5个拷贝,分别为256个特征(57.6k参数). 这个步骤可以将内容从一个副本移到另一个副本,这需要弹出,因为打入墙壁的块必须从+x+x副本移到-x-x副本. 由於相邻细胞的分化会横跨相邻细胞,它也可以通过一个细胞来移动内容. 然而,混音在每个单元格中应用相同的分量,所以无法分辨出一堵墙的位置,在一堵墙上转动块的内容必须来自所储存的文字. • 招标。 在预测阶段,一个有学识的解码器使来自细胞的预测相机框架在移动和混合之后以及该步骤的写出之前在视野中被设定。 • 写作。 一个有学问的变压器将一个框架写入了记忆. 它只更新了一套固定的177个单元格,60分之60分之60分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之6分之5分之5分之5分之5分之5分之5分之5分。 在背景阶段,它写真相机框. 在预测阶段没有相机相框,因此FloWM写出它刚刚在同一步骤上所渲染的相框. 我们称之为回信。

blocks.en: Three properties of this memory matter for our study. First, it never stores a block’s position as a number. The position is implied by which cells hold the block’s content, so a probe is needed to read it. Second, the memory can only carry motion that its five copies, together with the mix, can express. Third, its size grows with the area of the room and the number of velocities, not with the number of objects.
blocks.zh: 这个记忆的三种属性对我们的研究很重要. 首先,它从未将一个街区的位置作为数字存储。 其位置隐含着哪个细胞持有块的内容,因此需要一个探测器来读取. 其次,内存只能携带其5个拷贝连同混音可以表达的动作. 第三,它的大小会随着房间的面积和速度而增长,而不是随物体的数量而增长.

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows the protocol. Both memories receive the same videos. During the context phase, FloWM receives the 70 frames and actions, and the tracker receives oracle detections from the same 70 frames together with the same actions. During the prediction phase, both receive only the next 70 actions.

blocks.en:
At every one of the 70 predicted steps, each memory names one cell of the agent-centered 33 × 33 33\times 33 grid for each block, or states that the block is off the grid. This gives 1,090 possible answers. An answer is correct only if it is the cell that contains the block’s center at that step, counted in cells forward and to the right of the agent, so an answer one cell away counts as wrong.
The room is smaller than the grid, so the correct answer is never off the grid. Accuracy is the fraction of correct answers over all blocks and all predicted steps. Guessing at random would score below 0.1%.
blocks.zh:
在70个预测步骤中的每一个步骤,每个内存都取出一个以特效为核心的33×3333\times33个格子的每个格子,或者表示该格子脱离格子. 这就提供了1 090个可能的答案。 一个答案是正确的,只有当这个步骤上包含块中心的细胞,在细胞向前和代理人的右边计算,所以一个细胞离开一个细胞就算错。
房间比网格还小,因此正确的答案从不离网. 准确性是所有区块和所有预言步骤正确答案的分数. 随机猜测会得分低于0.1%.

blocks.en: Each video that we score with probes or the tracker contains six blocks, one of each color (red, blue, green, purple, gray and yellow), so each block can be identified by its color. We use 978 videos from the standard setting as a tuning set for training probes and for choosing the tracker’s settings. The tracker’s allowed speeds and the learned bounce use separate training videos (Apps. C and G ). We report results on 256 fresh videos from the standard setting, which we call the test set , and on 1,024 fresh videos from the varied setting. Confidence intervals are 95% intervals from resampling whole videos (a video bootstrap).
blocks.zh: 我们用探测器或追踪器得分的每段视频包含6个块,每个块有1个颜色(红色,蓝色,绿色,紫色,灰色和黄色),因此每个块都可以根据其颜色来识别. 我们使用来自标准设定的978个视频, 追踪器允许的速度和学会的回弹使用单独的训练录像(Apps.C和G.). 我们报告来自标准设定的256个新鲜视频, 信心间隔为95%,

blocks.en: A.5 Splitting the score
blocks.zh: A.5 分数

blocks.en: We split scores on the standard setting in three ways.
blocks.zh: 我们在标准设定上分出三分

blocks.en: In view or out of view. A block is in view at a predicted step if it lies inside the camera’s 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} field of view at that step, even if another block hides it. During the prediction phase no frames are shown, so a block in view is no more observed than a block behind the agent. About four in five answers on the test set are out of view (85,602 of 107,520).
blocks.zh: 以观相出或相出. 即使另一块隐藏在镜头内, 在预测阶段,没有显示帧,因此对视野中的块没有观测到的比物剂后方的块. 约五分之四的答案在测试集上脱离了视野(107,520分之85,602分).

blocks.en: Steps since the last sighting. A sighting is a context frame in which the block’s true mask covers at least 12 pixels. For each answer, we count the steps from the block’s last sighting to the scored step (Fig. 3 ). On the test set this count runs from 1 to 137. Sixteen of the 1,536 test blocks are never sighted during the context phase, and they give about 1% of answers, both in view and out of view. These answers have no count, so they appear in neither this split nor the split by number of sightings, but they stay in every other score. The tracker has no track for such a block, so all its answers for it are wrong, while FloWM finds 5.0% of them in view and 2.2% out of view.
blocks.zh: 上次看见之后的台阶 视线是该区块真正的口罩至少覆盖了12像素的上下文框架. 每一个答案,我们都会数起从街区最后一次目击到得分步骤(图3)的步骤。 在测试中,这个计数从1到137。 在1,536个测试区块中,有16个在上下文阶段从未看到过,它们给出了大约1%的答案,无论是对视还是对视. 这些答案没有计数,因此它们既不出现在这个分数中,也不出现在以目视次数划分的分数中,而是停留在所有其他分数中. 追踪器没有这样的块的音轨,因此它的所有答案都是错误的,而FloWM发现其中5.0%在取景地,2.2%在取景地.

blocks.en: Appendix B Probes
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: FloWM’s memory holds features rather than positions, so we need a probe to read a position out of it. We train one probe head per block color. Each head looks at the frozen memory at a predicted step, after that step’s write-back, and outputs one of the 1,090 answers for its color’s block. Heads are trained on memory states saved from the tuning videos and are then scored, unchanged, on the test videos. We use two probes.
blocks.zh: FloWM的记忆具有特征而不是位置,所以我们需要一个探测器来读取一个位置。 我们每块颜色训练一个探测器头 每一个头都以预想的一步观察被冻结的记忆, 头部接受从调音视频中保存的内存状态的培训,然后在测试视频上被打分,不变. 我们用两个探测器

blocks.en: The convolutional probe is the probe described in FloWM’s appendix. It is a convolutional network that sees the whole grid, with 7.06M parameters per head, which is more than half the size of FloWM itself (12.8M). Its code was not released, so we rebuilt it. Our rebuild scores 90.2% on the test set, while FloWM’s paper reports 96%.
blocks.zh: 演化探测器是FloWM附录所描述的探测器. 它是一个能看到整个电网的回旋网络,每头有7.06M参数,比FloWM本身(12.8M)大一半以上. 它的代码没有发布,所以我们重建了它. 我们的重建在测试中得分为90.2%,而FloWM的论文则报道了96%.

blocks.en: The single-cell probe scores each cell using only that cell’s own features in the five copies. It applies one small linear map, shared by all cells, and has 1,282 parameters per head. It cannot gather evidence from neighboring cells, and it cannot combine features in a nonlinear way. It can therefore find a block only where the memory stores that block in the correct cell.
blocks.zh: 单细胞探测器对每个细胞的评分只使用该细胞在5个副本中的自身特征. 它应用了一个由所有单元格共享的小线性映射,每个头有1,282个参数. 它不能从相邻的细胞中收集出证据,也不能以非线性的方式结合特征. 因此,它只能找到一个街区,即存储在正确的细胞中被屏蔽的记忆.

blocks.en: The tracker needs no probe. Its answer for a block is the grid cell that contains the position of the block’s last matched track, measured from the agent’s position and heading as computed from its actions, and rounded as the labels are. A block that was never sighted has no track, so its answers count as wrong.
blocks.zh: 追踪器不需要探测器 它对于一个区块的答案是包含该区块最后匹配轨迹位置的网格单元格,从代理商的位置和行驶方向上按其动作计算,并按标签进行四舍五入。 一个从未见过的街区没有轨迹,所以它的答案算错.

blocks.en: B.1 The probe changes the score
blocks.zh: 第B.1节 探测器改变分数

blocks.en: The two probes agree on blocks in view, where the single-cell probe scores 95.7% and the convolutional probe scores 96.5% (Table 2 ). They disagree on blocks out of view. The single-cell probe finds 66.1% of out-of-view blocks, while the convolutional probe finds 88.6%. About a quarter of the convolutional probe’s out-of-view hits therefore need information from neighboring cells or a nonlinear combination of features. For these blocks, the memory does not store the block in its own cell in a form that a simple read can find, and the probe computes part of the answer.
blocks.zh: 这两个探测器在视野中就区块达成一致,其中单细胞探测器的分数为95.7%,分数为96.5%(表2. 他们意见不一 单细胞探测器发现66.1%的出视区块,而分化探测器发现88.6%. 因此,大约四分之一的演化探测器的外出命中需要来自相邻细胞的信息或非线性特征组合. 对于这些块,内存不会以简单的读取可以找到的形式将块存储在自己的单元格中,而探测器会计算出部分答案.

blocks.en: This matters when we compare memories. Out of view, the tracker scores 90.8%. It is 2.1 points above FloWM read by the convolutional probe (CI 0.5 to 3.7), and about 25 points above FloWM read by the single-cell probe. We do not read the first gap as a win for the tracker, because our rebuilt probe scores below the published one. Which memory looks better therefore depends on the probe. Counting all answers in view and out of view, the convolutional probe scores 90.2%, the single-cell probe 72.1% and the tracker 90.8%.
blocks.zh: 这很重要 当我们比较记忆。 出道后,收视率达90.8%. 它在FloWM上方的2.1分由相生探测器读取(CI 0.5至3.7),在FloWM上方的约25分由单细胞探测器读取. 我们不认为第一个缺口是追踪器的胜利,因为我们重建的探测器得分低于公布的探测器。 哪个记忆看起来更好 取决于探测器。 盘点出视的所有答案,演化探测器得分为90.2%,单细胞探测器得分为72.1%,跟踪器得分为90.8%.

blocks.en: Appendix C The tracker with oracle perception
blocks.zh: 附录 C 有甲骨文感知的跟踪器

blocks.en:
A node memory takes the opposite approach to FloWM’s grid.
It stores one node per object. Each node holds the object’s position and velocity as explicit numbers, an uncertainty for each, and features that describe the object’s appearance. Each node moves by its own velocity, so the memory itself does not limit which velocities it can carry, and its size grows with the number of objects rather than the area of the room. A learned node memory must solve several core problems. It must find objects in the image, estimate their floor positions from the image, learn how they move and bounce, and decide which node each new sighting belongs to.
blocks.zh:
一个节点记忆对 FloWM 的网格采取了相反的方法.
它存储每个对象一个节点. 每个节点将对象的位置和速度作为明确数字,每个数字的不确定性,以及描述对象外观的特征. 每个节点都以自己的速度来移动,因此内存本身并不限制能携带的哪个速度,而其大小会随着物体数量而不是房间面积而增加. 一个已学到的节点记忆必须解决几个核心问题. 它必须在图像中找到物体,从图像中估计出它们的地平面位置,学习它们如何移动和回弹,并决定每个新的瞄准器属于哪个节点.

blocks.en: To separate the bookkeeping from these perception problems, we built the simplest node memory and gave it perception for free. This is a Kalman tracker that receives true block positions and masks from the simulator. It contains no trained networks.
blocks.zh: 为了把簿记和这些感知问题分开,我们建立了最简单的节点记忆,并免费给予它感知. 这是一个卡尔曼追踪器,从模拟器接收真正的块位置和口罩. 它没有训练有素的网络。

blocks.en: C.1 The Kalman filter
blocks.zh: 页:1 卡尔曼过滤器

blocks.en: A Kalman filter [ 15 ] keeps a best guess of an object’s state together with a measure of how uncertain that guess is. In the tracker, the state of each block is its floor position and velocity, ( x , y , v x , v y ) (x,y,v_{x},v_{y}) , and the uncertainty is a 4 × 4 4\times 4 covariance matrix. The filter alternates two steps. The predict step moves the guess forward by one time step using the current velocity, and it increases the uncertainty to allow for motion that the filter cannot foresee. The update step receives a measured position and moves the guess toward it. The size of this move depends on the two uncertainties. A confident prediction moves only a little, while a confident measurement moves it a lot. The filter never measures velocity directly. It infers velocity from how the measured position changes across sightings. A track that receives only one detection therefore keeps its starting velocity of zero, and it stays where the block was seen.
blocks.zh: 卡尔曼过滤器 [15] 保存了对物体状态的最佳猜测, 以及该猜测的不确定性的度量 。 在追踪器中,每个区块的状态是它的地平面位置和速度, (x, y, v x, v y) (x, y, v_{x}, v_{y}),不确定性是4×4 4\times 4同变矩阵. 过滤器替换了两个步骤 。 预测步骤利用当前速度将猜想向前移动了一时间步,并增加了不确定性来允许滤波器无法预见的运动. 更新步骤收到一个被测量的位置,并将猜想移向它. 这一动作的大小取决于两个不确定因素. 自信的预测只移动了一点点,而自信的测量则移动了它很多. 过滤器从不直接测量速度。 它从所测量的位置如何改变的角度推断出整个视线的速度。 因此,只接收到一次探测的轨迹将起跑速度保持在0,并停留在所看到的区块位置.

blocks.en: C.2 Matching and tracks
blocks.zh: C.2 匹配和跟踪

blocks.en: A tracker runs one filter per object and must decide which detection belongs to which filter. Our matching is in the style of SORT [ 3 ] , and the tracker repeats four steps at every time step. First, it predicts every track forward, and when a track’s center would cross a line one cell inside a wall, where a real block’s center turns around, it mirrors the track back and reverses its velocity on that axis. Second, it matches the detections in the current frame to tracks. The cost of a pairing grows with the distance between the detection and the track’s predicted position, measured against their combined uncertainty, and with their difference in mean color, which counts more the longer the track has gone unseen. Pairs farther apart than the 99% range of that uncertainty are not allowed, and the tracker repeatedly takes the cheapest allowed pair, so it assigns at most one detection to each track. A leftover detection may still join a track that has gone unseen for several steps, under a wider distance limit, if their colors nearly match. Third, it updates each matched track with its detection. Fourth, it starts a new track for each detection that matched no track. A track whose block is out of view receives no detection of that block, so it only predicts, unless a detection of another block is matched to it. Like FloWM, the tracker computes the agent’s own position and heading from its actions, which are exact in this environment.
blocks.zh: 一个跟踪器每个对象运行一个过滤器,必须决定哪个检测器属于哪个过滤器. 我们的相配是SORT [3]的风格,追踪器每一步重复四个步骤. 首先,它预言着每道前进,当一道跑道中心在一行一行的墙内会穿过一行一行的细胞时,当一个真正的块中心转过身来时,它会反射出这道跑道,并扭转它在该轴上的速度。 其次,它与当前框架中的检测结果相匹配来跟踪. 配对的成本随着探测和赛道的预测位置之间的距离而增加,并根据其组合的不确定性进行衡量,而他们的平均颜色差异也随之增加,这比赛道所未见的时间更长。 距离99%的不确定性范围更远的对等是不允许的,追踪器反复取出最便宜的允许对等,因此它最多为每道分配一次检测. 如果其颜色接近,剩余检测仍可能加入在更大距离限制下几步未见的轨道。 第三,它更新每个匹配的轨道 与它的探测。 第四,它开始一个新赛道 对于每个检测,匹配无赛道。 其块出视的轨迹没有收到对该块的检测,所以它只预测,除非对另一个块的检测与之相匹配. 像FloWM一样,追踪器会计算代理商自身的位置并从其动作中前进,这在这种环境下是准确的.

blocks.en: C.3 Speed snapping
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 速度快击

blocks.en: A velocity estimated from noisy positions is itself noisy, and a small velocity error grows into a large position error over a long gap. In the standard setting, every block moves at a speed of either 0 or 1 cell per step on each axis. The tracker uses this fact and snaps each axis of a track’s velocity to a speed of 0 or 1. During the context phase, it snaps an axis once its velocity estimate makes one of these speeds at least 99% probable, and it then holds that speed, reversing its sign at each bounce. When the prediction phase starts, it rounds every axis that has not yet snapped to the nearer of the two speeds. We found the two speeds from the velocities that the tracker itself estimated on 1,024 training videos of the standard setting, without true identities, and we chose the snapping thresholds on our tuning videos (App. A ). Speed snapping is knowledge about the standard setting, in the same way that FloWM’s built-in velocities are. For the varied setting we refitted the allowed speeds without labels on 1,024 varied training videos, which gives 0, 1 and 2 cells per step (App. F.2 ).
blocks.zh: 从噪音位置估计出的速度本身是噪音的,一个小的速度出错在很长的空隙中逐渐发展成一个大的位置出错. 在标准设置中,每个区块在每个轴上以每步0或1个单元格的速度移动. 追踪器利用了这个事实,把轨道速度的每个轴都扭到0或1的速度. 在上下文阶段,一旦其速度估计使其中一种速度至少有可能达到99%,它就会扭动出一轴,然后它会保持这个速度,每次弹出时都会反转它的标志。 当预测阶段开始时,它会环绕尚未断裂到两个速度更近的每个轴. 我们发现了追踪者自己估计的在标准设定的1 024个培训视频上的两个速度,没有真实的身份,我们选择了我们调制视频(App. 速度快就是对标准设置的了解, 对于各种设置,我们重新在1 024个不同的训练录像上添加了没有标签的允许速度,每个步骤给出了0、1和2个单元格(App.F.2)。

blocks.en: C.4 What the simulator gives the tracker
blocks.zh: 第C.4节 模拟器给追踪器什么

blocks.en: For every visible block in every context frame, the tracker receives the block’s true floor position with added random noise. The noise shifts the block’s bearing and its distance independently, each with a standard deviation of one image pixel, so the error grows with distance as it would for a real camera. The tracker also receives the uncertainty of each noisy position. It also receives the block’s true mask, and it uses the mean color inside the mask as the block’s appearance. It reflects tracks off the true wall positions. At scoring time, we must also know which track describes which block. We use the true identity of each detection for this purpose, and for each block we report the track that the block’s detections last matched. This readout is also an oracle step. FloWM’s probe receives similar help in another form, since it is trained with the true position of each block.
blocks.zh: 对于每个上下文框中的每一个可见块,追踪器都会通过添加随机噪声来接收块的真正地层位置. 噪声会独立地改变区块的轴承和相距,每个区块有一个像素的标准偏差,所以误差会随着相距而增大,像真正的相机一样. 追踪器还接收到每个有噪音位置的不确定性. 它也接收到块真正的口罩,它使用口罩内的正色作为块的外观. 它反映了真实的墙上位置上的痕迹。 在评分时,我们还必须知道哪条轨道说明哪个街区。 我们使用每个探测器的真实身份来达到这个目的,我们报告每个被探测器最后匹配的轨道。 这个读取也是神谕步骤. FloWM的探测器以另一种形式得到类似的帮助,因为它受到每个区块真实位置的训练.

blocks.en: C.5 How good can the tracker be?
blocks.zh: 第5条 追踪器能有多好?

blocks.en: Table 3: Out-of-view accuracy (%) of tracker variants on the standard test videos. The row marked “the tracker” is the tracker of the main text. The upper rows score all 85,602 out-of-view answers. The lower rows score only the 83,202 out-of-view answers for blocks sighted in at least two context frames. A restart predicts a block forward from the tracker’s estimate at its last sighting, with no further matching.
blocks.zh: 表3:标准测试视频中跟踪器变体的外视精度(%). 标有“跟踪者”一行是主要文本的跟踪者。 上行取出所有85,602个出道答案. 下行只获得至少两个上下文框所看到块的83,202个出视答案. 重启会预示追踪器在最后一次目击时会从估计值中向前走出一个街区,没有进一步的匹配.

blocks.en: Because the tracker receives oracle inputs, its score is a ceiling for this tracker design and a reference point for a learned node memory. We first check that it is a strong reference. It keeps identities well, with an IDF1 score of 95.6% [ 25 ] . IDF1 measures how many detections a tracker assigns to the correct identity, balancing missed and wrong assignments. Table 3 shows how the tracker’s out-of-view accuracy depends on its inputs and on speed snapping.
blocks.zh: 由于跟踪器接收到甲骨文输入,它的分数是这种跟踪器设计的上限和学习到的节点内存的参考点. 我们首先检查它是否是一个有力的参考。 其身份保存良好,以 IDF1 得分95.6% [25]. IDF1测量一个跟踪器为正确身份分配的检测次数,平衡了错失和错误的任务. 表3显示追踪器的出视精度如何取决于其输入和速度快快。

blocks.en: Speed snapping carries most of the tracker’s strength under noise. With exact positions, speed snapping changes little (94.3% against 93.7%). Noise of a single pixel cuts this to 47.1%, because noisy positions give noisy speeds and the errors grow over long gaps. Speed snapping restores the score to 90.8%. These allowed speeds match the standard setting. For the varied setting we refitted them and ran the tracker once on the varied test videos (App. F.2 ).
blocks.zh: 速度快能承受追踪器的大部分力量。 由于位置准确,速度的起落变化很小(94.3%对93.7%)。 单像素的噪声将这个比例削减到47.1%,因为吵吵的姿势会发出吵闹的快感,而错误会随着长时间的缺口而增加. 速度快快将分数恢复到90.8%. 这些允许速度与标准设置相匹配 。 对于不同的设定,我们重新进行了测试,并在不同的测试视频上运行了一次跟踪器(App.F.2)。

blocks.en: The lower rows of Table 3 show where the remaining error comes from. For each block sighted at least twice, we restart the block from the tracker’s own estimate at its last sighting and predict it forward with no further matching. This restart scores 94.3%, slightly above the tracker’s 93.4% on the same answers. The difference is error that enters after the last sighting, for example when a detection of another block is matched to the track. Giving the restart the true velocity raises it to 97.8%, so velocity error at the last sighting costs about 3.5 points. We froze the tracker’s settings on the tuning set, but only after we had seen some test-set results.
blocks.zh: 表3的下行显示剩余出错的来源. 我们从追踪者自己的估计中重新开始, 这一重启得分为94.3%,略高于同样答案上的追踪者93.4%. 区别是上次瞄准后进入的错误,例如当对另一个块的检测被匹配到轨道时. 赋予重启的真实速度将它提升到97.8%,所以最后一次瞄准时的速度出错大约3.5分. 我们冻结了追踪器在调制组上的设置,

blocks.en: Appendix D Write-back
blocks.zh: 附录D 回写

blocks.en: During the prediction phase no block is observed, whether it is in view or not. Yet the convolutional probe scores 8 points higher on blocks in view than on blocks out of view (Table 2 ). One explanation would be that blocks in view were seen more recently. To test this, we compare blocks in view and out of view that have the same number of steps since their last sighting. On the test videos, FloWM keeps an in-view advantage of 7 to 10 points in every bin from 5 steps on, and every confidence interval lies above zero † \dagger . The tracker has no such advantage. Weighted to the same mix of steps since the last sighting, its in-view score minus its out-of-view score is − - 0.1 points (CI − - 1.2 to 0.9), while FloWM’s is + + 7.5 points (CI 6.7 to 8.4).
blocks.zh: 在预测阶段,无论是否在视野内,都未观察到区块。 然而,进取探测器在视区比在视区外的取出分高8分(表2)。 一种解释是,人们最近看到一些块。 为了检验这一点,我们比较了自上次看到以来有相同步骤的形而上学的形而上学的形而上学。 在测试视频上,FloWM保持了从5个步骤到每个垃圾箱的7到10分的内视优势,每个置信间隔都在0~\dagger上方. 追踪器没有这种优势. 被加权到自上一出目击以来相同的步数组合,其入场比分减去出场比分为--0.1分(CI−1.2分至0.9分),而FloWM出场比分为++7.5分(CI 6.7分至8.4分).

blocks.en: The likely cause is FloWM’s write-back. At each predicted step, FloWM renders a frame and writes it back into the cells in view. When a block enters the camera’s view during the prediction phase, its probe accuracy rises from 84.8% to 92.4% on the tuning videos (read by heads trained on the other half of the tuning videos), although nothing new is observed † \dagger . On the test videos, read by the convolutional probe, it rises from 89.6% to 94.2% (4.6 points, CI 3.7 to 5.5), while the tracker stays at 90.5%. We also read the memory just before each write on the tuning videos, but the probe was trained on memory read after the write and scores lower before it even on blocks that stay in view (84.1% against 96.5%), so this read cannot say how much of the in-view advantage the write-back causes. During prediction the written frame is computed from the memory itself, so the write adds no new information about where blocks are. In-view scores therefore mix memory with the model’s own predictions, and we compare the two memories on blocks out of view.
blocks.zh: 可能的原因是FloWM的回信。 FloWM在每一个预想的步骤上,都会制作出一个帧并写回视图中的单元格. 当一个块在预测阶段进入相机的视线时,它的探测器精度从84.8%上升至92.4%的调频视频(由接受过另外一半调频视频训练的头部读取),尽管没有观察到任何新的 \\dagger 。 在由分解探测器读取的测试视频上,它从89.6%上升到94.2%(4.6分,CI 3.7分上升到5.5分),而追踪器则停留在90.5%. 我们还在调音视频上每次写之前就读过内存,但探测器在写完后读过内存训练,甚至在保留在视线上(84.1%对96.5%)的块上都得分更低,因此这个读取无法说明回想原因的内景优势有多大. 在预测期间,书面框架是从内存本身计算出来的,所以书面没有添加关于块所在的新信息. 因此,实景评分将内存与模型本身的预测相混合,我们比较了两个在外景区块上的记忆.

blocks.en: Appendix E Time since the last sighting
blocks.zh: 附录E 自上次目击以来的时间

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows how accuracy on out-of-view blocks changes with the steps since the last sighting. FloWM falls from 96% at 2 to 4 steps to between 89% and 90% from 10 to 99 steps, and it ends at 82%. The tracker starts higher, at 97%, and falls further, to 72%. The ranking therefore flips. Hollow markers in Fig. 2 mark bins with fewer than 1,000 answers. At 10 to 19 steps, the tracker leads by 6 points (CI 4 to 8). At 100 to 139 steps, it trails by 10 points (CI 4 to 16) † \dagger .
blocks.zh: 图2显示自上次目击以来,外景区块的精确度随着步骤的变化而变化. FloWM从2到4步的96%下降到10到99步的89%到90%,最终达到82%. 追踪器开始较高,为97%,进一步下降至72%。 因此,排名翻转。 Fig中的"洞"标记,2个有不到1000个答案的"标记". 10到19步,追踪者领先6分(CI 4到8分). 在100到139步,它追出10分(CI 4到16分)\dangger.

blocks.en: This flip does not by itself show that FloWM’s memory fades more slowly. The late bins hold different kinds of blocks from the early bins, and two causes explain the tracker’s late deficit. We found both after seeing the results † \dagger .
blocks.zh: FloWM的记忆逐渐消退。 迟到的垃圾桶与早到的垃圾桶有着不同种类的区块,有两个原因可以解释追踪者的迟到赤字. 我们在看到结果后发现的

blocks.en: The first cause is blocks sighted only once. Such a block gives the tracker a position but no velocity. Its track either stays where the block was seen or, for 13 of the 15 such blocks at 100 to 139 steps, is also updated by detections of other blocks, and in either case the tracker finds almost none of them. These blocks make up 14% of out-of-view answers at 100 to 139 steps but only 0.6% at 10 to 19 steps. The tracker finds 0.6% of them, while FloWM finds 30.2%. FloWM appears to infer a block’s direction from a single sighting. To check this, we took answers for blocks sighted only once in which the block’s last-seen cell and the cells it would reach in each of the four directions all differ. Among FloWM’s answers that land on one of the four direction cells, 89% pick the true direction, where guessing would give 25% (tuning videos). We have not identified the cue that FloWM uses.
blocks.zh: 第一个原因是只看到一次街区。 这样的块会给追踪者一个位置,但没有速度. 它的行迹要么停留在看到区块的地方,要么在15个区块中的13个区块在100至139个台阶下,通过对其他区块的探测也进行更新,在这两种情况下,追踪者都发现几乎没有一个区块. 这些区块在100到139步时占出场答案的14%,但在10到19步时只占0.6%. 追踪器发现了其中的0.6%,而FloWM发现了30.2%. FloWM似乎从一次目击中推断出一个街区的方向. 为了检查这一点,我们只找到了一次被观测到的区块的答案,其中区块的最后一个区块的细胞和四个方向中每个区块的细胞都不同。 在FloWM的回答中,89%的人选择了真正的方向,其中猜测会给出25%(调取视频 ) 。 我们还没有找到FloWM使用的提示 。

blocks.en: The second cause is error that enters a track during the context phase after the block’s last sighting, such as a match to another block’s detection. For blocks sighted at least twice, we restart each block from the tracker’s estimate at its last sighting, as in App. C . The restart beats the tracker by 6.7 points at 100 to 139 steps and by nothing at 10 to 19 steps. A long gap since the last sighting means that the context phase continued for many steps after it. During those steps, a detection of another block can be matched to the track and pull it away. Such errors do not show until the track is scored.
blocks.zh: 第二个原因是在区块最后一次瞄准之后的上下文阶段进入轨道的错误,例如与另一个区块的探测相匹配. 对于至少两次看到的区块,我们像App.C一样,在最后一次目击时从追踪者估计的每个区块重新开始。 重启后在100至139步以6.7分击败了跟踪者,在10至19步以一无所获. 自上次目击以来存在了很长的空白,这意味着背景阶段在之后继续了许多步骤。 在这些步骤中,对另一块的探测可以与赛道相匹配并拉走. 这种错误在音轨被打出之前不会显示 。

blocks.en: Splitting the gap by how often each block was sighted makes this precise. Blocks sighted once account for 4.1 of the 9.8 points (CI 0.9 to 7.9), and blocks sighted at least twice account for the other 5.7 (CI − - 0.2 to 11.7). For the latter, error that enters after the last sighting accounts for 5.8 points (CI 1.7 to 10.4), which is the 6.7-point loss against the restart weighted by these blocks’ share of the bin, and the restart itself scores 0.1 points above FloWM (CI − - 4.8 to 4.6). We made this split after we had seen the results † \dagger .
blocks.zh: 以每个区块的视线 来划分空隙, 使得这个精确。 视斑曾占9.8分中的4.1分(CI 0.9至7.9分),而视斑至少两次占另外5.7分(CI - - - 0.2至11.7). 对后者来说,在最后一次瞄准后进入的误差占5.8分(CI 1.7至10.4),这是以这些块所分量加权的重启损失6.7分,重启本身的得分高于FloWM(CI - - 4.8至4.6). 我们看到结果后就分道扬镳了

blocks.en: Appendix F Varied setting
blocks.zh: 附录F 不同的设置

blocks.en: F.1 FloWM on velocities outside its built-in set
blocks.zh: F.1 FloWM 内置套件以外的速度

blocks.en: The probe scores in this subsection are overall accuracy, over answers in view and out of view. Appendix F.2 gives out-of-view values by motion type (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 本分节中的探针分数是总体准确的,大于视线和视线外的答案. 附录F.2按运动类型列出视外值(表6)。

blocks.en: The mix layer could, in principle, let FloWM carry more velocities than its five copies. Since the mix can move content by one cell, a block moving two cells per step could be carried by a one-cell shift in a copy plus a one-cell move in the mix. Training on the varied setting tests whether FloWM learns to do this. We compare four models. The first is the released checkpoint, which was trained on the standard setting. The second is the released checkpoint fine-tuned on the varied setting for 20k steps. The third and fourth are trained from scratch for 150k steps with FloWM’s recipe, one on the varied setting and one on the standard setting. The from-scratch standard model checks how well our training run reproduces the released model.
blocks.zh: 混合层原则上可以让FloWM携带比其五份更快的速度. 由于混合可以由一格移动内容,每步移动两个细胞的块可以由复制件中的一格移取再由混合件中的一格移取. 培训FloWM是否学会进行各种设置测试。 我们比较了四个模型。 第一个是已放行的检查站,该检查站接受了标准制定方面的培训。 二是已放行的检查站在各种设置上对20克台阶进行了微调. 第三个和第四个是用FloWM的食谱从零开始训练,一个是不同的设定,一个是标准设定。 从抽取标准模式 检查我们的训练运作如何 复制了释放的模式。

blocks.en: We measure each model in two ways. The first is the MSE of predicted frames on 1,000 clips per setting, over 70 predicted frames, which needs no probe. The second is probe accuracy on the varied test videos, split by motion type into built-in, diagonal, and speed 2. For the released model, we read the varied videos with the convolutional probe trained on the standard setting, used unchanged. We also trained probe heads on the varied setting while the model generated new rollouts, rather than from saved memory states. We use such heads to read the fine-tuned and retrained models, whose memories the standard heads have never seen. Heads trained this way on the standard setting are scored on a separate set of 1,024 fresh standard videos, which include the 256 test videos.
blocks.zh: 我们以两种方式衡量每个模型。 第一种是每设定1000个片段的预测帧的MSE,超过70个预测帧,不需要探测. 第二是各种测试视频上的探测精度,按运动类型分为内置,对角和速度2. 对于发布的模型,我们读取各种视频,其中包含经过标准设定培训的进化探测器,使用不变. 我们还对探测器头进行了关于各种环境的培训,而模型则产生了新的推出,而不是来自所保存的内存状态。 我们用这样的头来读取经过精细调整和再训练的模型,标准头们从未见过这些模型的记忆. 在标准设定上这样训练的头被分到另外一套1,024个新鲜的标准视频上,其中包括256个测试视频.

blocks.en: Table 4: FloWM on the varied setting, as overall accuracy (%) over answers in view and out of view. The standard-video column is on 1,024 fresh standard videos, which include the 256 test videos, and every score in it comes from heads trained on the standard setting while the model generated rollouts. The varied-video columns are on the 1,024 varied test videos and use the heads named in the second column. MSE is on 1,000 clips with 70 predicted frames. Built-in means one cell per step along one axis. Heads marked ∗ were trained while the model generated rollouts, and the other heads were trained on saved memory states. Probe scores carry no interval.
blocks.zh: 表4:不同场合的FloWM,作为整体准确度(%)大于视差和视差的答案. 标准视频栏目收录了1,024个新鲜标准视频,其中包括256个测试视频,其中的每个分数都出自在标准设定方面受过训练的头部,而模型则产生推出. 各种视频栏目在1,024个不同的测试视频上,并使用第二栏所命名的头. MSE在1000个剪辑上,有70个预测帧. 内建-指一轴一行一格. 标有*头被训练,而模型则被推出,其他头被训练关于被保存的内存状态. 探测分数没有间隔.

blocks.en: For the released model, the convolutional probe trained on the standard setting, used unchanged on varied videos, finds 75.8% of blocks that move at a built-in velocity (Table 4 ). It finds only 3.6% of diagonal blocks and 4.3% of speed-2 blocks. On built-in-velocity blocks it scores 14 points below the 90.2% it scores on the standard test videos (CI 13 to 16). This drop may come from the memory itself, or from memory states that the probe never saw in training. Probe heads trained on the varied setting fit their own training videos at 93% but find only 6.2% of blocks in fresh varied videos, so we rely on the probe trained on the standard setting for the released model. The MSE, which needs no probe, is 23 times higher on the varied setting than on the standard setting.
blocks.zh: 对于公布的模型,经过标准设定培训的革命探测器在各种视频上使用不变,发现75.8%的区块以内置速度移动(表4)。 它只发现了3.6%的对角地块和4.3%的速-2地块. 在内置高速区块上,它得分低于标准测试视频(CI 13至16)得分90.2%的14分. 这种下降可能来自内存本身,或者来自内存中表示探测器在训练中从未见过. 试探头接受过不同设置的训练, MSE不需要探测器,在各种设置上比标准设置高23倍.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning on the varied setting for 20k steps halves the MSE on the varied setting. It also doubles the MSE on the standard setting. Its probe finds only 13% to 15% of diagonal and speed-2 blocks.
blocks.zh: 对20k步的不同设置进行微调,将不同设置的MSE减半. 它还在标准设置上将MSE翻了一番. 它的探测器只发现了13%至15%的对角和速度-2区块.

blocks.en: Training from scratch on the varied setting for 150k steps gives a varied-setting MSE only 1.33 times its own standard-setting MSE (CI 1.28 to 1.39). Its probe, however, finds only 10.5% to 11.8% of diagonal and speed-2 blocks, against 20.7% of built-in-velocity blocks. This model is also weak overall. Its MSE on the varied setting is 12.2 times the released model’s MSE on the standard setting. On standard clips, its MSE is 9.1 times the released model’s, and its probe finds 30.5% of blocks, against 86.9% for the released model read by the same kind of probe. Our from-scratch run on the standard setting missed the released MSE by more than 10% (0.000820 against 0.000603 on the release’s validation clips), so our training recipe may be weaker than the original. With one seed per run, these results neither show nor rule out that the mix layer can extend the built-in velocities.
blocks.zh: 从头到尾对150k步骤的不同设置进行培训,使设定不同的MSE只提供1.33倍于自身标准设定的MSE(CI 1.28至1.39). 然而,它的探测器只发现对角和速度-2区块的10.5%至11.8%,而内置速度区块的20.7%. 这一模式总体上也十分薄弱。 在不同的设置上,它的MSE是发布模型的MSE在标准设置上的12.2倍. 在标准剪辑上,它的MSE是释放模型的9.1倍,它的探测器发现有30.5%的区块,而由同一种探测器读取的释放模型则为86.9%. 我们从标准设定上运行, 错过了超过10%的MSE(0. 有了每跑一出一出种子,这些结果既不显示也不排除混合层可以延长内置速度.

blocks.en: Taken together, FloWM’s memory carries blocks whose motion matches its five velocities and largely loses the rest. Covering the varied setting’s 24 velocities with built-in shifts would take 25 copies of the grid, one of them still, or 7.0M numbers instead of 1.4M [ 20 , their Apps. F and G.1] . Training that model is out of scope for this work.
blocks.zh: FloWM的记忆中, 覆盖不同环境的24个时速, 这一模式的培训超出了这项工作的范围。

blocks.en: F.2 The tracker on the varied test videos
blocks.zh: F.2 联合国 各种测试视频的跟踪器

blocks.en: We ran the tracker once on the 1,024 varied test videos, the videos on which FloWM is scored above. Before any test video was read, we froze the code and settings and registered the run and its headline number. The headline is out-of-view accuracy on diagonal and speed-2 blocks for the tracker with allowed speeds 0, 1 and 2. Each of five configurations ran once, and Table 5 reports every number as it came out. Each configuration scores 430,080 answers, of which 342,917 are out of view, and 19 blocks were never sighted in context. In-view and overall accuracy are within about half a point of the out-of-view values.
blocks.zh: 我们在1,024个测试视频上运行过追踪器, 在任何测试视频被读取之前,我们冻结了代码和设置,并注册了运行及其头条号码. 头条为对角和速度-2区块的外视精度,为可允许速度为0,1和2. 5个配置各运行一次,表5显示每个数字。 每个配置的分数为430,080分,其中342,917分出镜,19个街区从未在上下文中看到. 内视和整体准确度在外视值的约半分以内.

blocks.en: With allowed speeds 0, 1 and 2, the tracker finds 93.9% of out-of-view diagonal and speed-2 blocks. On the same answers, FloWM’s released model, read by the convolutional probe trained on the standard setting, finds 4.1%. The paired difference is 89.8 points (CI 89.1 to 90.5). Table 6 gives FloWM’s out-of-view accuracy by motion type for all four rows. The other three rows saved no per-answer outputs, so their values are unpaired point estimates from accuracies logged per motion type. Pooled over diagonal and speed-2 blocks they score 2.9%, 12.6% and 9.1%.
blocks.zh: 以允许速度为0,1和2,追踪器发现了93.9%的出视对角和速度为2的区块. 在同样的答案中,FloWM的发布模型,由经过标准设定训练的分解探测器读取,发现4.1%. 成对相差为89.8分(CI 89.1至90.5). 表6按运动类型列出FloWM所有四行的外景精度. 其他三行没有保存每回回回输出,因此其值是从每个运动类型记录的速率得到的未发光点估计. 聚集在对角和速度2区块上 他们得分2.9%,12.6%和9.1%。

blocks.en: The tracker of the main text, with allowed speeds 0 and 1, keeps diagonal blocks (93.1%) and loses speed-2 blocks (4.9%). Per-axis speeds of 0 and 1 can express one cell per step on each axis, but not two. On speed-2 blocks this tracker does worse than the tracker with no speed snapping (59.5%), so snapping to a wrong speed hurts more than not snapping. With exact positions, speed snapping makes no difference to the score over all blocks (97.0% with and without it).
blocks.zh: 主文本的跟踪器,允许速度为0和1,保持对角块(93.1%)并失去速度为2的块(4.9%). 每轴速度为0和1可以表达出每个轴上每步一个细胞,但不能表示两个. 在速度-2上,这个跟踪器比没有速度快(59.5%)的跟踪器更糟糕,所以快到错误的速度会比不快更痛. 在准确位置上,速度快快无异于所有区块的分数(97.0%有和没有).

blocks.en: Three caveats apply to the headline number. The tracker receives oracle detections, and it knows the true walls. Its allowed speeds were fitted without labels on 1,024 varied training videos, but its other settings did not pass our own selection rule. Before tuning, we fixed that a setting qualifies only if, with one-pixel noise, IDF1 reaches 95% with at most 1.1 nodes per block, and if, with exact positions, it does at least as well as no speed snapping. On 256 varied validation videos no setting passed (best IDF1 86.5%). We therefore kept the settings chosen for the standard setting, after the varied probe-training videos had already been run with these allowed speeds.
blocks.zh: 头条号适用三条提示. 追踪器接收到甲骨文检测,它知道真实的墙壁. 它允许的速度在1 024个不同的训练录像上没有标签,但是它的其他设置没有通过我们自己的选择规则。 在调音之前,我们确定一个设置只有在以下情况下才符合条件:在一像素噪声下,DF1达到95%,每个区块最多有1.1个节点;在精确的位置下,它至少能达到并且没有速度快快。 在256个不同的验证录像中,没有通过设置(最佳的以色列国防军1 86.5%)。 因此,我们保留了为制定标准所选择的设置,在此之前,各种探测训练录像已经以这些允许的速度播放。

blocks.en: Table 5: The tracker on the 1,024 varied test videos: out-of-view accuracy (%) by motion type, and IDF1 (%). Each configuration ran once, after the code and settings were frozen and the run was registered.
blocks.zh: 表5: 1 024个测试视频的跟踪器:按运动类型分列的视线外准确度(%),以及DF1(%)。 每个配置运行一次,在代码和设置被冻结并注册运行之后.

blocks.en: Table 6: FloWM on the 1,024 varied test videos: out-of-view accuracy (%) by motion type, on the same answers as Table 5 . The first row comes from per-answer outputs. The other rows come from accuracies logged per motion type, and their last column assumes the first row’s answer counts.
blocks.zh: 表6:1 024个测试视频上的FloWM:按运动类型分列的视外精度(%),答案与表5相同。 第一行来自每个回答输出. 其他各行来自每行运动类型的速率记录,其最后一行承担第一行的答数.

blocks.en: Appendix G Learned bounce
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en:
The tracker’s bounce is an exact reflection off the true walls, an oracle that a learned node memory will not have.
We therefore tried to learn the bounce instead, while still telling the tracker where the walls are. This experiment used the tracker with the exact reflection replaced by a learned gate, described below, and it ran on training videos of the standard setting that we generated rather than on our evaluation videos. These videos hold six to ten blocks in the same six colors, so most repeat a color, and color alone cannot tell two blocks apart. Before training, the gate leaves every velocity unchanged, so each track moves at constant velocity and unseen tracks pass through walls. On the tuning videos, this untrained variant keeps identities far worse than the tracker, with an IDF1 of 67.9% against 95.2%.
blocks.zh:
追踪器的回弹是真实墙壁上的精确反射,是学习过节点记忆不会拥有的神谕.
因此,我们试图学习反弹,同时仍然告诉追踪者墙在哪里。 这个实验使用了跟踪器,精确的反射被下面描述的一个有学识的门所取而代之,它运行在了我们制作的标准设定的培训视频上,而不是我们的评价视频上. 这些视频以相同的6个颜色持有6到10个街区,所以大多数都重复了一种颜色,而仅用颜色无法分辨出两个街区相隔. 在训练前,大门会留下每个速度不变,所以每个跑道都以恒定速度行走并有看不见的跑道穿过墙壁. 在调音视频上,这个未经训练的变体使身份比跟踪器要差得多,其一为GDF167.9%而95.2%.

blocks.en:
We added a gate that acts when a track is near a wall.
The gate multiplies the track’s velocity on that axis by a learned factor m m . A factor of m = 1 m=1 continues, m = 0 m=0 stops, and m = − 1 m=-1 reverses. We trained m m to reduce the track’s position error each time a block is seen again.
We measure matching quality as the share of the tracker’s matches that join a detection to a track started by another block. We changed the training objective after seeing early results, so we treat this experiment as a diagnostic † \dagger .

blocks.en: A tracker’s motion model does two jobs. It predicts where an unseen block has gone, and it decides which track a new detection joins. Training it only to predict can therefore harm the second job. With no bounce model, the tracker matches 17.5% of detections to the wrong block. With exact reflection off the true walls, it matches 16.3%. With the learned bounce, it matches between 19% and 26%, across three learning rates and training steps 100 to 500. Learning the bounce made matching worse than having no bounce model at all.
blocks.zh: 追踪器的运动模式有两个功能。 它可以预测一个隐形的块已经消失的地方, 它决定了哪个跟踪一个新的探测器加入。 因此,训练它只能预测会损害第二项工作。 由于没有回弹模型,追踪器将17.5%的检测结果与错误的区块相匹配. 准确反射出真实的墙壁, 匹配16.3%。 随着学习的回弹,它比对19%到26%,在三个学习率和培训阶段100到500。 学习弹出比没有弹出模型更糟糕

blocks.en: Two errors explain this result, which we examine at a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and step 500. First, tracks whose speed was fixed by speed snapping learn to stop at the wall rather than bounce. the median learned factor is m = − 0.006 m=-0.006 on the 6,375 steps where a block reaches the wall and keeps its velocity, and none of the 3,533 separate steps where it reverses gets a negative factor (median + 0.545 +0.545 ). When a track cannot tell whether its block will continue or reverse, stopping halfway lowers the average squared position error. However, it leaves the track behind the block, where it can capture another block’s detection. Second, tracks that have drifted, and whose speed is not fixed, reverse on 89% of the steps where the block in fact keeps going. Together, these errors raise the number of wrong-block matches from 3,928 to 5,738.
blocks.zh: 两个错误解释了这个结果,我们以10 - 3 10 - 3 - 3 3 的学习率和500级来检查。 首先,速度被速度所固定的轨道会学会停止在墙上而不是回弹. 在6,375个步骤上,一个区块到达墙上并保持其速度;在3,533个单独的步骤中,一个区块逆向得到负因子(中间值+0.545+0.545),中位学习因子为m = − 0.06 m =-0.006。 当一个音轨无法分辨其块是否会继续或倒转时,停止中途会降低平均平方位置错误. 然而,它留下了街区后面的轨道,可以捕捉到另一个街区的探测. 第二,已漂移而速度未固定的轨迹,在89%的步道上倒行逆行,区块实际上继续前进. 这些错误加在一起,错误块匹配的数量从3,928个增加到了5,738个.

blocks.en:
Given oracle positions and masks, the tracker updates its memory with about 10 5 10^{5} to 10 6 10^{6} arithmetic operations per context step, by our hand count, and its state takes 14 KB. FloWM’s write of one frame takes 1.5 × 10 10 1.5\times 10^{10} operations over a 5.6 MB grid.
Of this cost, 96% grows with the 885 memory entries it updates, which are the 177 cells in view times the five copies. This comparison flatters the tracker, because FloWM also perceives, and a deployed tracker would need a detector and a position estimator whose cost would dominate. The tracker’s state also has a practical benefit. It stores each block’s position and velocity as numbers, so no trained probe is needed to read them once tracks are linked to objects.

blocks.en: We made the choices marked † \dagger after we had seen results. The first is the split by number of sightings and what builds on it: the two causes of the tracker’s late deficit, the split of that deficit by number of sightings (App. E ) and the restart rows of Table 3 . The second is the training objective of the learned bounce, which we changed after seeing early results (App. G ). The third is the comparison of in-view and out-of-view accuracy at equal steps since the last sighting, which we proposed after seeing FloWM’s in-view lead, together with the analysis of blocks entering view that followed it (App. D ). The fourth is the pair of bins quoted for the flip, 10 to 19 and 100 to 139 steps, since we have no record that we chose this pair in advance. blocks.en: Four further disclosures apply. No setting of the tracker with allowed speeds 0, 1 and 2 passed our pre-set selection rule, so we kept the standard setting’s settings after seeing results on varied videos outside the test set, and its run on the varied test videos was registered in advance (App. F.2 ). We froze the tracker’s settings for the standard setting on the tuning set, but only after we had seen some test-set results. A few numbers come from tuning or training videos and not from test videos: the read before the write, FloWM’s choice of direction after a single sighting, the first of the two measurements of a block entering view, and the learned bounce. The FloWM values for the fine-tuned and retrained models in the lower half of Table 2 are pooled from logged aggregates and carry no interval.
blocks.zh: 还有四项披露适用。 没有设定允许速度为0、1和2的跟踪器通过了我们预设的选择规则,因此我们在看到测试器外的各种视频的结果之后保留了标准设定的设置,并且它在不同测试视频上的运行是事先注册的(App. F.2 )。 我们冻结了追踪器在调制组上设定标准的设置,但只是在我们看到了一些测试结果之后。 几个数字来自调音或训练视频,而不是测试视频:写作前的读取,FloWM在一次目击后选择方向,一个块入景的两个测量中的第一个,以及学到的回弹. 表2下半部分的微调和再训练模型的FloWM值从记录的集合中集合,没有间隔。
